{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''being''' working for the [[Orko SkyMine Asteroid Processing Corporation]] of [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga the Hutt]] authored a file on the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt's]] resources. The aim of the file was to prepare for the corporation's [[Mining/Legends|mining]] project there, but true purpose of the project was to construct the [[Darksaber (superweapon)|Darksaber]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The failure of the [[Automated Mineral Exploiter]]s in extracting the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids']] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]&mdash;the machines scrapped each other instead&mdash;was witnessed from a former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base by a team of Orko SkyMine individuals that included the author. The author subsequently wrote an incident report regarding the mining disaster, closing the piece with the recognition that they were at the mercy of Durga. Indeed, the identity of the author was purged and they were potentially [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] by the displeased [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
